protocols.https: works, but requires a bot-check cookie round-trip: the first request to a given URL gets a 302 back to itself with a Set-Cookie: bcheck=true, and only a second request carrying that cookie returns the real file/404. A client without cookie-jar support (or that gives up after one redirect) will see this mirror as permanently broken.

round2_no_mirror_found.windows_rubyinstaller_binaries: SJTU's github-release proxy (via rubyinstaller.cn) is a real, currently-unconfirmable lead behind a WASM bot-check; every other China-mirror candidate in the brief (ISCAS/HUST/NYIST/BFSU) doesn't carry this repo or is blocked. No other distribution project (rvm/travis-ci, Chocolatey) repackages the identical file -- Chocolatey embeds it unmodified inside a .nupkg, which is useful for checksum_corroboration (added, see NOTES.md) but not a fetchable mirror URL.

round2_checksum_corroboration.how: The .nupkg bundles the exact upstream RubyInstaller .exe rather than downloading it at install time; extracted and sha256-verified 20 files across 10 package versions (2.2.6 through 3.4.4.1) against releases.json entries matched by the embedded filename. 20/20 matched, 0 mismatches, 14 were previously null-checksum. Script: catalog/package-managers/round2/ruby/mine_chocolatey.py (re-runnable, --all mines the remaining ~29 published versions).
